mapper.sql: uuid, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, external_id, thread_id, worker_epoch, sandbox_uuid, attempt, tool_name, input, state, deadline_at, timeout_ms, lease_expires_at, cancel_requested_at, cancel_reason, stop_grace_until, result, result_object_key, result_bytes, result_sha256, finalizer, finalizer_state, finalize_timeout_ms, finalize_until, error_code, late_result, created_at, updated_at, finished_at
mapper.select: SELECT cs.uuid AS uuid FROM code_sessions cs JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = cs.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid JOIN environment_work work ON work.session_uuid = s.uuid AND work.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND work.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND work.environment_uuid = cs.environment_uuid AND work.state = 'active' AND work.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN environment_sandboxes sandbox ON sandbox.work_uuid = work.uuid AND sandbox.organization_uuid = cs.organization_uuid AND sandbox.workspace_uuid = cs.workspace_uuid AND sandbox.environment_uuid = cs.environment_uuid WHERE cs.organization_uuid = #{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND cs.workspace_uuid = #{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND cs.external_id = #{scope.CodeSessionID} AND sandbox.uuid = #{scope.SandboxUUID} AND cs.status = 'active' AND cs.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status <> 'terminated' AND sandbox.state = 'running' AND sandbox.provider_sandbox_id IS NOT NULL FOR SHARE OF work, sandbox
SELECT FROM sandbox_tool_calls WHERE organization_uuid = #{organizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND uuid = #{callUUID} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sandbox_tool_calls ( uuid, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, code_session_uuid, external_id, thread_id, worker_epoch, sandbox_uuid, attempt, tool_name, input, state, deadline_at, timeout_ms, lease_expires_at, cancel_requested_at, cancel_reason, stop_grace_until, result, result_object_key, result_bytes, result_sha256, finalizer, finalizer_state, finalize_timeout_ms, finalize_until, error_code, late_result, created_at, updated_at, finished_at ) VALUES ( #{row.UUID}, #{row.OrganizationUUID}, #{row.WorkspaceUUID}, #{row.CodeSessionUUID}, #{row.ExternalID}, #{row.ThreadID}, #{row.WorkerEpoch}, #{row.SandboxUUID}, #{row.Attempt}, #{row.ToolName}, #{row.Input, sensitive=true}, #{row.State}, #{row.DeadlineAt}, #{row.TimeoutMS}, #{row.LeaseExpiresAt}, #{row.CancelRequestedAt}, #{row.CancelReason}, #{row.StopGraceUntil}, #{row.Result, sensitive=true}, #{row.ResultObjectKey}, #{row.ResultBytes}, #{row.ResultSHA256}, #{row.Finalizer}, #{row.FinalizerState, sensitive=true}, #{row.FinalizeTimeoutMS}, #{row.FinalizeUntil}, #{row.ErrorCode}, #{row.LateResult, sensitive=true}, #{row.CreatedAt}, #{row.UpdatedAt}, #{row.FinishedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (code_session_uuid, thread_id, external_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE sandbox_tool_calls SET sandbox_uuid = #{row.SandboxUUID}, attempt = #{row.Attempt}, state = #{row.State}, deadline_at = #{row.DeadlineAt}, lease_expires_at = #{row.LeaseExpiresAt}, cancel_requested_at = #{row.CancelRequestedAt}, cancel_reason = #{row.CancelReason}, stop_grace_until = #{row.StopGraceUntil}, result = #{row.Result, sensitive=true}, result_object_key = #{row.ResultObjectKey}, result_bytes = #{row.ResultBytes}, result_sha256 = #{row.ResultSHA256}, finalizer = #{row.Finalizer}, finalizer_state = #{row.FinalizerState, sensitive=true}, finalize_timeout_ms=#{row.FinalizeTimeoutMS}, finalize_until = #{row.FinalizeUntil}, error_code = #{row.ErrorCode}, late_result = #{row.LateResult, sensitive=true}, updated_at = #{row.UpdatedAt}, finished_at = #{row.FinishedAt} WHERE uuid = #{row.UUID} AND organization_uuid = #{row.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid = #{row.WorkspaceUUID}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sandbox_tool_calls WHERE AND code_session_uuid = #{codeSessionUUID} AND state = 'pending' AND deadline_at > #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED

SELECT FROM sandbox_tool_calls WHERE (state IN ('pending','dispatched') AND deadline_at <= #{now}) OR (state = 'dispatched' AND lease_expires_at <= #{now}) OR (state = 'running' AND (deadline_at <= #{now} OR lease_expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' <= #{now})) OR (state = 'cancel_requested' AND (lease_expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' <= #{now} OR stop_grace_until <= #{now})) ORDER BY LEAST( deadline_at, COALESCE(CASE WHEN state = 'dispatched' THEN lease_expires_at ELSE lease_expires_at + INTERVAL '30 seconds' END, deadline_at), COALESCE(stop_grace_until, deadline_at) ), id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE environment_sandboxes SET tool_call_ready_at=NOW() WHERE organization_uuid=#{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid=#{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND uuid=#{scope.SandboxUUID} AND state = 'creating' AND provider_sandbox_id IS NOT NULL AND tool_call_ready_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT state FROM environment_sandboxes WHERE organization_uuid=#{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid=#{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND uuid=#{scope.SandboxUUID} AND provider_sandbox_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM environment_sandboxes WHERE organization_uuid=#{organizationUUID} AND workspace_uuid=#{workspaceUUID} AND uuid=#{sandboxUUID} AND tool_call_ready_at IS NOT NULL AND state IN ('creating','running')) AS ready

SELECT s.uuid AS uuid FROM sessions s JOIN code_sessions cs ON cs.session_uuid=s.uuid AND cs.organization_uuid=s.organization_uuid AND cs.workspace_uuid=s.workspace_uuid WHERE cs.organization_uuid=#{scope.OrganizationUUID} AND cs.workspace_uuid=#{scope.WorkspaceUUID} AND cs.external_id=#{scope.CodeSessionID} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status <> 'terminated' FOR SHARE OF s
